desc:
🌍 WORLD AT WAR 🌍

⚔️ Choose your country. Build your army. Conquer the world.

Lead your nation through WAR, DIPLOMACY, ALLIANCES, PUPPETS, PEACE DEALS, AND TOTAL CONQUEST in a fast-paced strategy game where every decision matters.

🪖 Spawn armies
💣 Declare wars
🤝 Form alliances
🏳️ Puppet defeated nations
🗺️ Expand your empire
🔥 Dominate multiple maps and eras

Play quick EUROPE matches for fast conquest, or fight longer WORLD wars for deeper strategy.

Can you build the strongest empire… or will your country fall?

Please report any bugs if you encounter any
